Options:
  --with PACKAGE  Include additional dependencies
  --with-editable PACKAGE  Include an editable dependency
  --force  Replace existing entry points
  --reinstall  Reinstall packages
  --upgrade  Allow upgrades
  --python PYTHON  Select a Python interpreter
  --offline  Disable network access
  --no-cache  Disable caching
  --directory DIRECTORY  Change working directory
  --project PROJECT  Select project directory
